name: Pdf Extraction (OCR)
description: Extract text from page images with Tesseract, with no PDF library; rejects a PDF with a typed error naming what it would need.
install: Install the optional dependencies first with: uv add pytesseract pillow. pytesseract also needs the tesseract binary on PATH.
missing_dependency_message: pdf-extraction-ocr requires 'pytesseract' and 'pillow', which are not installed. Install them with: uv add pytesseract pillow
